about: Within a relatively short period of time, NYC Personal Injury Attorney Jacob Green has emerged as a beacon of judicious advocacy and client care within his legal community, helping his clients get the compensation they deserve for enduring traumatic injuries due to no fault of their own. At the law office of Gair, Gair, Conason, Rubinowitz, Bloom, Hershenhorn, Steigman & Mackauf in New York City, New York, he serves residents throughout the surrounding, and he is also licensed to practice law in New Jersey as well.

Mr. Green completed his undergraduate studies in 2014, graduating magna cum laude with his Bachelor of Arts degree in journalism and mass communication from the Arizona State University Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication. He went on to attend Penn State Law, where his legal and academic prowess was on full display in activities such as the Philip C. Jessup International Law Moot Court Team. In addition, he served on the Moot Court Executive Board and as the Director of Competitions. He received his Juris Doctor in 2017, and in the same year, he was inducted into the Order of Barristers.

With a desire to accumulate practical experience in the legal field, Mr. Green as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Robert B. Reed of the Superior Court of New Jersey, and later went on to serve as an assistant prosecutor at the Essex County Prosecutor’s Office, exposing him to the inner workings of the judiciary he operated in; an experience he now uses to help his clients in their legal woes.
honors: Jacob was included in the New York Metro Super Lawyers “Rising Stars” list in 2023 and 2024.
